assessment.simple_git: Two critical and two high advisories remain installed. Git workflow node, source-control and promotions modules stay explicitly disabled; native loader and module-registry tests verify denial. Upstream simple-git 4.0.2 breaks the n8n Git default import and changes environment semantics, so no untested major override is applied.
assessment.braces: One high advisory remains and upstream has no patched npm release. The real file-selector helper runs complex patterns in a worker with a deadline; a deeply nested pattern is rejected while the main process stays responsive. Other observed consumers use deployment-controlled loader paths/proxy patterns. The active workflow has only Webhook, If and Matrix nodes.
assessment.compiler: Native Dependency-Track currently reports 25 additional Go findings in TypeScript 7.0.2 bundled tsc (Go 1.26.4, x/text v0.38.0), not in the Node.js HTTP server. No newer supported TypeScript 7.x release exists on 2026-10-20. The active workflow does not execute the compiler; these findings remain visible, not suppressed.
assessment.feed_difference: Fresh npm audit has one moderate sprintf-js advisory absent from the native Trivy/Dependency-Track findings. Before this change: 29 direct npm advisories and 53 native findings (28 npm plus 25 Go).
